# AVANI Foundation

> AVANI Foundation — Advancing Vision, Ambition and New Independence — is an emerging non-profit initiative based in Uttar Pradesh, India, dedicated to women's empowerment, digital inclusion and economic independence. It helps women and girls turn potential into opportunity through digital skills, AI readiness, content creation, entrepreneurship, mentorship and access to opportunities.

## What AVANI works on

- Digital Careers & Creator Economy — content creation, digital storytelling, personal branding, freelancing
- Future Skills & AI Readiness — digital literacy, AI awareness, cyber safety, introductory STEM
- Opportunity Access & Public Services — guidance on government schemes, scholarships and job portals
- Women Entrepreneurs & Business Growth — business skills, financial literacy, digital commerce
- Leadership, Confidence & Personal Development — mentorship, career guidance, counselling
- Climate Innovation & Green Livelihoods — green entrepreneurship and sustainable livelihoods
- Women's Nutrition & Food Literacy — balanced nutrition and informed health choices

## Approach

Confidence → Capability → Career: mentorship and personal development first, then future-ready skills, then pathways to employment, freelancing, business ownership and leadership.

## Pages

- Home (/): mission, approach, focus areas, programmes, founder profile and contact form
- Donate (/donate): bank transfer and UPI donation details

## Founder

Mani Pandey — background in gender advocacy, global politics (University of Oxford) and marketing (MBA, Symbiosis Pune); worked with UN Women India and on India's G20 Presidency women's empowerment initiatives.
